messages:
varek (new-hire): Hi folks, Varek here. My first on-call rotation is Thursday. Two blockers: I can't open the runbook attachments and my OpsGenie test page timed out. Also, where's the 'quick mitigation' cheatsheet?
emma (oncall-lead): Welcome Varek! Runbook attachments are permissioned separately. Drop your SSO and @kai will add the ACL. Quick mitigation cheatsheet is pinned at the top of the runbook under 'Fast Mitigations'.
kai (sre): Added varek@redwood.com to runbook-attachments group. Give it a minute and refresh. For OpsGenie timeout: ensure your timezone and device are set in profile, and that push notifications are allowed.
ops-bot: Action: Enroll device in MDM to receive background notifications: https://mdm.redwood.internal/enroll
varek (new-hire): I refreshed and can access attachments now, thanks. I enrolled in MDM but test page still shows "delivery timeout".
kai (sre): If MDM is enrolled, try toggling push in OpsGenie app, and check mobile OS does not suppress background refresh. Also confirm your device is listed under OpsGenie -> Devices.
varek (new-hire): Toggle worked, I got the push. Quick question about severity: is there a simple checklist to choose Sev1 vs Sev2 under presence of a partial feature outage?
emma (oncall-lead): Short rule: Sev1 = customer-facing outage impacting majority or SLA, Sev2 = partial degradation or subset of customers, Sev3 = internal or negligible customer impact. Use the 'sev decision tree' in runbook for edge cases. If unsure, mark Sev2 and escalate to oncall-lead.
varek (new-hire): Got it. Also saw a note about "exec notice" template and thought: who signs off before we send an exec page?
emma (oncall-lead): Exec pages should be used sparingly. Template: "SEV1: <short impact> — mitigation in progress — incident lead: <name> (<phone>)". For hosted-prod Sev1 with revenue impact, page execs and CC @vpeng and @headops. If you're shadowed, have your shadow or oncall-lead sign off first.
varek (new-hire): One more tech thing: model-serving healthcheck returns 500 from my laptop but 200 from jumpbox; I think it's a routing issue. Any known onboarding network quirks?
kai (sre): New hires sometimes miss internal route injection. Run `tailscale status` then `sudo ip route`. If 10.0.0.0/8 missing, re-run tailscale up and re-auth. If still missing, ping infra.
varek (new-hire): Re-auth fixed it. FYI found a tiny doc mismatch: the runbook's 'contact table' macro didn't render for me until attachments ACL changed. Might confuse other new hires.
emma (oncall-lead): Good catch. I'll file a Confluence macro support ticket. Also note: first two rotations are shadowed (we'll schedule the shadowing), and we expect acknowledgement messages in Slack to include one-line status + next step.
devx-bot: Reminder: Mock incident drill tomorrow 19:00 PT. Join for a hands-on walkthrough.
pagerbot: Scheduled: Varek shadow with Emma  2026-06-12 19:00-03:00 UTC. Good luck! :robot_face:
